title: Book One · Chapter 173: A Place for the Stool
story:
At half past one on Saturday, the stool comes through the classroom door.

Mum carries one side. Leo's mother carries the other. Ronan holds the door wide enough for both of them.

“Here?” Mum asks.

He points to the place beside the chair. The plan shows the stool beside that chair.

The real chair is wider than the little square on the paper.

Mum puts the stool down. Leo comes through with a box, turns sideways, and catches his shirt on the chair back.

“I can get past,” he says.

“Your shirt cannot,” Mei tells him.

She sets down her drawings and frees the cloth. There is no tear. Leo pulls the shirt straight.

Ronan looks at the plan. The chair and stool fit very well there. He looks up at the door. They do not fit so well here.

“Can we try the chair over there?” he asks.

Ronan points to the other wall. Miss Wu looks there. It is against the other wall, clear of the tables.

“Yes. Keep this way open.”

Mum helps him move the chair. Then Mei walks in with her box. This time she comes straight through.

Leo follows her with a second box.

“My shirt says thank you.”

“Tell it to stay near you,” Ronan says.

They laugh. Mum goes to hang her blue bag beside its card. The three light books are still inside. She checks the handle before she leaves it for visitors to try.

Ronan brings out the stool card. Dad's small yes is on the back. The simple words are on the front. Dad agreed to those words. The small drawing shows the repaired leg.

He puts it on the low table beside the seat.

Mei crouches down to read it.

“People will stand to read it. It is too low for them.”

“Too high for you?” Leo asks.

“I am not standing.”

Ronan tries sitting on the stool. He can see the card, but his knee nearly touches it. He moves the card to the side of the table. Now it faces the door.

Leo stands up straight. Now he can read it. Mei walks through again. Nothing catches her box or her coat.

Miss Wu comes over and sits down.

“I can see the whole street from here.”

Ronan looks at the plain wooden seat. Miss Wu can rest on it and see the map. He is glad they brought it.

He wants Dad to see it. Dad may not be able to come. That is still true.

Mr Qiu brings the pad and empty pencil box. He leaves them with Miss Wu. Then he goes back to put the afternoon sign at his table. Leo sees his pencil by the map. He left it there yesterday. He puts the answer pad beside his door game. Mei checks the backs of her pictures. Then she sets them out.

Beside the blue river, they set out three little paper boats. They used their old school notes to make these boats. The little boats are new for this display. Leo adds a folded paper bridge. Ronan sends one boat under it, then leaves it at the river's edge.

Ronan starts to move one of Mei's drawings nearer the front.

“This one stays here,” she says.

He takes his hand away. “All right. Where do you want the empty paper?”

She shows him the smaller table. Children can draw there. Her pictures are on the other table. The children can draw on their own paper here.

Mum's friend finishes carrying the last box. Ronan thanks her. She must go somewhere else before two. She looks at the map. Then she says goodbye and leaves.

They are ready to check the room. They will walk round it like visitors. Ronan goes to the door and starts there.

He finds the place for his bag. Then he sees the start of the map. There is a seat if he needs one.

Then a gust of wind lifts one corner of Mei's drawing.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达
- stool：凳子。
- plain：朴素的、没有装饰的。
- crouch：蹲下。
- get past：从旁边通过。

## 理解
1. 为什么凳子最后放在门边？
2. Ronan 怎样尊重父亲对旧事的选择？
